proceedings.outcome: property belonging to the applicant - the ship Stavanger and a floating drydock - was frozen
proceedings.supporting_quote: Following the institution of an investigation against the applicant in March 1995, on 5 October 1995 property belonging to the applicant - the ship Stavanger and a floating drydock - was frozen on the order of the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office.

proceedings.outcome: the proceeds from the ship sale were frozen
proceedings.supporting_quote: on 11 March 1996 the proceeds from the ship sale were frozen on the order of the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office.

proceedings.outcome: the prosecutor’s office unfroze the account and transferred the money to the yard
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 18 May 1996 the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office unfroze the account and transferred the money to the yard.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant was found guilty on some of the charges and sentenced to one and a half years in prison
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 21 April 1997 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on some of the charges, and not guilty on most. He was sentenced to one and a half years in prison

proceedings.outcome: the conviction was quashed and the case was remitted to the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: In July 1997 the Supreme Court quashed the conviction on the applicant’s appeal and remitted the case to the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court.

proceedings.outcome: the motion to detain the applicant was rejected as unsubstantiated
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 30 March 1998, during the new trial, the prosecutor applied to the court to detain the applicant... The Regional Court rejected the motion as unsubstantiated.
On 1 April 1998 the local electoral committee declared the elections invalid on the ground of irregularities committed during the campaign by some candidates, including the applicant.

proceedings.outcome: the motion for detention was granted and the applicant was arrested
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 2 April 1998 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court granted the prosecutor’s renewed motion for detention on grounds of obstruction of justice and violations of the undertaking not to leave the city, and the applicant was arrested in the course of the hearing.

proceedings.outcome: the appeal against the detention order was rejected on the grounds that national law did not allow such separate appeals
proceedings.supporting_quote: The reply from the Supreme Court, dated 19 May 1998, stated that the national law did not allow appeals against that type of trial court orders separately from appeals against judgments.

proceedings.outcome: requests to dismiss the judge for bias and to admit a new lawyer were rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 19 May the applicant’s “civil defender” requested the Regional Court to dismiss the judge presiding in the case for bias... On the same day the applicant requested to admit Mrs Moskalenko as his lawyer in the trial... Both requests were rejected by the Regional Court.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant was found guilty on multiple charges and sentenced to six years in prison
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 27 May 1998 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on charges of misappropriation and embezzlement, larceny, bribery and attempt not to return money from abroad... In total, the court sentenced him to six years in prison

proceedings.outcome: the court issued several orders noting procedural breaches during investigation
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 27 May 1998 the Regional Court made a number of further orders ( частные определения ) in the case... In one order the court noted breaches of the relevant rules of criminal procedure during investigation

proceedings.outcome: the court ordered that the applicant should be given the amended version of the judgment
proceedings.supporting_quote: It appears that on 8 July 1998 the Regional Court ordered that the applicant should be given the amended version

proceedings.outcome: the judgment was confirmed with some alterations and the sentence of six years was upheld
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 10 August 1998 the Supreme Court confirmed the judgment of the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court, with some alterations... The sentencing of the applicant to a total of six years in prison was upheld.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant's first (1982) conviction was quashed and the file closed
proceedings.supporting_quote: In February 1999 the applicant’s first (1982) conviction was quashed, and the file in that case was closed by the Nizhniy Novgorod regional prosecutor’s office.
